picks.name: Wallabee Shoe, Maple Suede
picks.why: One of the Black Friday targets, now £79.20 (20% off) with UK 10 in stock, already under the target price a week early. There are no Wallabees in the wardrobe, and they fill both the office and everyday shoe slots without the weight of boots. Wear them with the fawn chinos and a navy knit, or the 502s and a raglan sweat. Spray the suede with protector first.

picks.name: Anglistic Sweater, Speckled Dark Scarab
picks.why: Knits are still the biggest gap: none owned, and the office and outdoor outfits both need one. This is a regular-fit lambswool raglan crew in a dark speckled green with just a small woven hem label, 30% off with L in stock (only L and XL left). Wear it over a plain tee with the fawn chinos and brown Docs, or under the waxed jacket with the 502s.

picks.name: Headland LS Slub Henley, Dusty Olive
picks.why: Tees remain the other big gap. A regular-fit organic slub cotton long-sleeve henley in washed olive, 40% off, with only a small pocket tab. Wear it alone with the navy chinos and Sambas, or under the grey marl raglan sweat or the field jacket.
